name: Elfia Arcen
blurb: A fantasy and cosplay festival at Kasteeltuinen Arcen (Arcen Castle Gardens) in Limburg, Netherlands, with costume parades, music and workshops.
notes: The most recent confirmed Arcen edition ran September 19-20, 2026, which is before this window's start (2026-10-05). elfia.com's own Programme page for Arcen (elfia.com/Programme?lm=arcen) describes the festival's activities but names no 2027 date; only a 'Vorden 2027 Ticket' is currently being sold on the official site. Third-party festival calendars (medievalbooker.com, dagjeweg.nl) expect the next Arcen edition around the third weekend of September 2027 (about Sept 18-19) but say this is not yet officially confirmed, so per the no-guessing rule no edition is listed here; check back once elfia.com announces it. No guest lineup is posted either, consistent with no edition being announced yet.
